notes: Review follow-up of 08 P2-3b (B-L8), an invariance gate: Wall.appendLikeLast takes its id from Wall.allocateId, the 07 6.8 nextFree over the live ids (07 4.1). Whenever nextSectionId is above every live id, which holds in every state the harness reaches (no scenario imports an id near 2^31 - 1), allocateId returns exactly the legacy nextSectionId++, so no output may change. It differs only after an import whose ids reach the top of the id range, where P2-3b's replaceAll falls back to the smallest unused id and the legacy ++ then handed out ids that live sections already used (covered by domain.test.mjs and wall-controller.test.mjs).
